lede: Seattle Seahawks carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#10 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Denver Broncos +2.0 with a fair total of 42.5 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Denver Broncos pass offence vs Seattle Seahawks pass defence, which sits −0.193 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is quarterback information: Seattle Seahawks and Denver Broncos have no confirmed starter on file, which materially affects how much confidence the exact number deserves.
